paragraphs: The Home Depot, Inc. is an American multinational home improvement retail corporation which sells tools, construction products, building materials, appliances, and services including fuel and transportation rentals. Home Depot is the largest home improvement specialty retailer in the United States. In fiscal 2024, the company reported $159.5 billion in revenue and approximately 470,100 associates. The company is headquartered in Cobb County, Georgia, with an Atlanta mailing address.

Home Depot operates many big-box format stores across the United States (including the District of Columbia, Guam, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands); all 10 provinces of Canada; and all 31 Mexican states and Mexico City. Interline Brands (The Home Depot Pro), a maintenance, repair, and operations company is also owned by The Home Depot, with 70 distribution centers across the United States. It is the seventh largest United States–based employer globally.

people.name: William D. Bastek
people.title: Executive Vice President - Merchandising
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President of Merchandising, Hardlines from January 2019 to March 2023 and Merchandising Vice President for hardware and tools from December 2013 to January 2019. Began his career at HD Supply in 1989.
people.quote: WILLIAM D. BASTEK, age 59, has been Executive Vice President - Merchandising, since March 2023.

people.name: Jordan Broggi
people.title: Executive Vice President - Customer Experience and President - Online
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President and President - Online from May 2022 to June 2024 and held senior finance roles at the Company. Before joining in 2013, held finance and strategy positions with LexisNexis, Bain & Company, and General Motors.
people.quote: JORDAN BROGGI, age 42, has been Executive Vice President - Customer Experience and President - Online since June 2024.

people.name: Angela Brown
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer
people.bio: Started her Company career in 1998 as an associate systems engineer. Previously served as Senior Vice President of Information Technology from May 2022 to May 2025 and Vice President, Information Services from 2017 to May 2022.
people.quote: ANGELA BROWN, age 50, has been Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer since May 2025.

people.name: Ann-Marie Campbell
people.title: Senior Executive Vice President
people.bio: Began her career with the Company in 1985 as a cashier and held roles of increasing responsibility. Previously served as Executive Vice President - U.S. Stores and International Operations from October 2020 to October 2023.
people.quote: ANN-MARIE CAMPBELL, age 60, has been Senior Executive Vice President since November 2023.

people.name: John Deaton
people.title: Executive Vice President - Supply Chain & Product Development
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President - Operations from April 2021 to October 2021 and Senior Vice President - Supply Chain from May 2017 to April 2021. Earlier roles included Senior Vice President - Brand and Product Development and Vice President - Supply Chain.
people.quote: JOHN DEATON, age 52, has been Executive Vice President - Supply Chain & Product Development since November 2021.

people.name: Edward P. Decker
people.title: Chair, President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Has served as President and Chief Executive Officer since March 2022 and Chair since October 2022. Joined the Company in 2000 and previously served as President and Chief Operating Officer and Executive Vice President - Merchandising.
people.quote: EDWARD P. DECKER, age 63, has served as our Chair since October 2022

people.name: Richard V. McPhail
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Joined the Company in 2005 and held roles of increasing responsibility in finance, strategy and business development, including Senior Vice President, Finance Control and Administration. Previously served as executive vice president of corporate finance for Marconi Corporation plc.
people.quote: RICHARD V. McPHAIL, age 55, has been Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since September 2019.

people.name: Teresa Wynn Roseborough
people.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Previously held legal positions at MetLife, including Senior Chief Counsel - Compliance & Litigation and Deputy General Counsel. Earlier served as a partner at Sutherland Asbill & Brennan LLP and a Deputy Assistant Attorney General in the U.S. Department of Justice's Office of Legal Counsel.
people.quote: TERESA WYNN ROSEBOROUGH, age 67, has been Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since November 2011.

people.name: Michael Rowe
people.title: Executive Vice President - Pro
people.bio: Previously served as President of The Home Depot Canada from October 2020 to February 2025 and Vice President of Online, Marketing and Contractor Services from November 2016 to October 2020. Joined the Company in 2006 and held various roles for The Home Depot Canada, including Chief Financial Officer.
people.quote: MICHAEL ROWE, age 58, currently serves as Executive Vice President - Pro.

people.quote: Our Board currently has 12 members: Gerard J. Arpey, Ari Bousbib, Jeffery H. Boyd

people.name: Gregory D. Brenneman
people.title: Lead Director
people.bio: Executive Chairman of CCMP Capital Advisors, LP. He has served in various CEO roles and, as Home Depot's Lead Director, has guided leadership transitions and management changes.
people.quote: Gregory D. Brenneman currently serves as our Lead Director and brings to the role a high level of energy, engagement and oversight.

people.name: J. Frank Brown
people.title: Director
people.bio: Former Managing Director and Chief Risk Officer of General Atlantic LLC. The Board has determined that he is an audit committee financial expert.
people.quote: Jeffery H. Boyd, Gregory D. Brenneman, J. Frank Brown, Edward P. Decker

people.name: Edward P. Decker
people.title: Chair of the Board

people.quote: Jeffery H. Boyd, Gregory D. Brenneman, J. Frank Brown, Edward P. Decker

people.name: Wayne M. Hewett
people.title: Director
people.bio: Senior advisor to Permira since March 2018, Chairman of Cambrex Corporation since December 2019, and Chairman of Quotient Sciences since October 2023. His career includes CEO roles at Kl ckner Pentaplast Group and Arysta LifeScience Corporation and over 20 years with General Electric.
people.quote: Mr. Hewett is a seasoned executive leader who has worked across a number of industries.

people.name: Manuel Kadre
people.title: Director
people.bio: Chairman and CEO of Kollective Auto Group since 2012 and Chairman of the Board of Republic Services, Inc. Previously, he was CEO of Gold Coast Caribbean Importers, LLC and held several leadership roles at CC1 Companies, Inc.
people.quote: Mr. Kadre is Chairman and CEO of Kollective Auto Group (formerly known as MBB Auto Group)

people.name: Stephanie C. Linnartz
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as President, CEO and a director of Under Armour from February 2023 through March 2024. Previously, she was President of Marriott International and held other senior leadership roles there after joining in 1997.
people.quote: Ms. Linnartz served as the President, CEO and a member of the board of directors of Under Armour, Inc.

people.name: Paula A. Santilli
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as PepsiCo's CEO, Latin America Foods, from January through December 2025, after serving as CEO, Latin America, from 2019 to 2024. Previously, she held leadership positions at PepsiCo Mexico Foods, including President and COO.
people.quote: Ms. Santilli served as the CEO, Latin America Foods, for PepsiCo, Inc.

people.name: Caryn Seidman-Becker
people.title: Director
people.bio: CEO of CLEAR since she and a co-founder purchased and relaunched its predecessor in 2010, and Chair of CLEAR's board. Previously, she founded and served as managing partner of Arience Capital and held roles at Iridian Asset Management and Arnhold and S. Bleichroeder.
people.quote: Ms. Seidman-Becker has served as the CEO of CLEAR, a secure identity platform operating in travel, healthcare, sports and entertainment

people.name: Asha Sharma
people.title: Director
people.bio: Executive Vice President and CEO, Microsoft Gaming, since February 2026, following leadership roles in Microsoft's AI business. Previously, she was COO of Instacart, held product leadership roles at Facebook, and served as COO and Chief Marketing Officer of Porch Group.
people.quote: Ms. Sharma has served as Executive Vice President and CEO, Microsoft Gaming, with Microsoft, a computer software provider, since February 2026.
